name: STIHL MSA 200 C-B
blurb: Battery saw. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″: 56, 64 and 72 drive links on 10″, 12″ and 14″ (71 PM3), per STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The MSA 200 C-B is a battery saw. STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists 10″, 12″ and 14″ bars with 71 PM3 56, 71 PM3 64 and 71 PM3 72. Pitch and gauge are the identifying panel's reading of that marketing number: 7 is 1/4″ PICCO and 1 is .043″.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 71 PM3 56 with recommended bar 3005 008 3403. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel on the same catalog pages defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

STIHL's chart lists chain 71 PM3 64 with recommended bar 3005 008 3405. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel on the same catalog pages defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

STIHL's chart lists chain 71 PM3 72 with recommended bar 3005 008 3409. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel on the same catalog pages defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.
